response.sql: WITH matched AS (SELECT a.translink AS translink, t.ordertypedist AS ordertypedist, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.transreg = a.translink WHERE a.peercorr > 0.149 AND t.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.translink, t.ordertypedist) SELECT translink, ordertypedist, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / SUM(cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY ordertypedist) AS fraction FROM matched ORDER BY fraction DESC LIMIT 10
